The end result achieves a sublime balance of leather and pepper.

name: Grand Cru
description: Davidoff Grand Cru cigars were created with the vision of being crafted like classic Bordeaux wine. Now, like the rich, ripe grapes of Bordeaux, the fruits of another piece of innovation have been harvested and turned into a truly remarkable cigar, one even more deserving of the title Grand Cru. The Diademas Finas Limited Edition Collection incorporates tobacco aged in Premier Grand Cru red wine casks from Bordeaux. In the spirit of Zino’s pioneering blends, this is the first time where a wine cask aged tobacco has been used. A San Vicente seco tobacco is matured for six months in the casks. As a result, the flavour carries the same notes which characterise the chateaux wines - dark cherries, walnuts and citrus. The combination rolls around in the mouth like wine being swirled in a glass. To add extra distinctiveness to this Limited Edition, it comes in the striking figurado format.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Grand Cru
description: This slightly longer Corona’s higher proportion of Ligero tobacco gives the complex nut and wood flavors of Grand Cru No. 2 unforeseen strength and depth.
filler: San Vicente Ligero, Pilot Seco, Olor Seco - All from DR

name: Grand Cru
description: Grand Cru No. 5 packs complexity and aroma into a short Petit Corona format, ideal with an aperitif or a well-earned coffee break.
filler: San Vicente Ligero, Pilot Seco, Olor Seco - All from DR

name: Grand Cru
description: Finally, the Grand Cru blend arrives in a Robusto format.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Grand Cru
description: The beautiful Toro format introduces itself with a charming, creamy sweetness. Less woody flavours than one would find with the Robusto, more earthy notes await you. And in the second third, discover subtle milk coffee notes. The Toro is, until the very last puff, a pleasantly surprising, utterly charming cigar
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Aniversario No. 1 2023 Limited Edition
description: First created in 1986 to celebrate Zino Davidoff's 80th birthday. Today, Davidoff re-rolls its cigar history and brings back this beloved cigar as a Limited Edition of only 20,800 boxes worldwide. The impressive Double Corona size allows for a pronounced development of all three parts of the cigar. In the first third, herbal aromas complement warm notes of cedar wood and cream. Moving on, citrus and fresh spice are dominated by savoury notes of roasted nuts. As the cigar approaches its grand finale, hints of fresh spice harmonise with flavours of walnuts and cedar wood.
filler: Piloto visus, San Vicente visus, San Vicente Mejorado visus from Dominican Republic

name: Chefs Edition LE 2025
description: The Chefs Edition 2025 blend incorporates select tobaccos from Davidoff's iconic White Band Collection, mirroring the chef's signature lightness and finesse. To introduce fresh notes while enhancing complexity, Davidoff's Master Blenders meticulously experimented with a variety of tobaccos and ageing techniques. The cigar opens with notes of cayenne pepper, followed by sweet whipped cream. The Yagua-aged tobacco brings complex floral aromas to the blend. As the journey continues, an impressive bouquet of flavours emerges. Cayenne pepper is still present in the retrohale, while notes of perfumy rosewood, leather and a subtle hint of lemon entertain the palate. Towards the end of the cigar, the intensity increases slightly, unveiling a crescendo of fresh spice, coffee and oak wood. Perfumed flavours from the second third give way to more robust notes.

name: Escurio 10th Anniversary Gran Toro - LE 2025
description: With its generous 56-ring gauge, the gran toro format provides the perfect platform for this captivating blend. It allows the vibrant flavours of the Brazilian and Dominican tobaccos to fully express themselves, creating a truly dynamic and unforgettable sensory experience. With a remarkable 45-year combined age for its tobaccos, this is a fitting celebration for the 10th Anniversary of the introduction of the Escurio range.
wrapper: Ecuadorian Havana Seed grown in Ecuador
filler: Mata Fina and Cubra from Brazil, San Vicente, Piloto and Olor from DR

name: London 40th Anniversary Limited Edition
description: Only 300 boxes have been made for our 40th anniversary. The blend was selected as a fuller bodied cigar with great ageing potential inspired by Art Editions from 2014 to 2016. An expression of Edward Sahakian's favourite size with Eddie Sahakian's favourite blends.
filler: Piloto Seco, Yamasa Visus, San Vicente Visus and San Vicente Seco all from the Dominican Republic

name: Oro Blanco Special Release 111
description: Davidoff is proud to introduce an exclusive successor to the exceptional Oro Blanco; The Davidoff Oro Blanco Special Reserve 111 Years. THE BACKGROUND In 2014, Davidoff created the Davidoff Oro Blanco Special Reserve 2002, an exceptional cigar with a blend comprised of the rarest tobaccos grown in the richest of soils and patiently aged for over 12 years before being made into what was then Davidoff’s rarest cigar. The incredible success and demand for this luxurious offering has led to predictions that the product will be sold out by the end of 2024. Davidoff is therefore proud to introduce an exclusive successor: The Davidoff Oro Blanco Special Reserve 111 Years. THE CIGAR The toro features a Dominican puro blend of vintage tobaccos from five different terroirs in the Dominican Republic.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Winston Churchill Limited Edition 2025 - The Artist
description: Sir Winston Churchill's love of art is the inspiration that led the Davidoff Master Blenders to compose the latest of the Churchill Range limited-edition cigars. The multi-origin blend is a complex yet harmonious taste journey of nuts, coffee and cedar wood that would have been the perfect accompaniment for one of Sir Winston’s painting sessions. The packaging design of the Davidoff Winston Churchill Limited Edition 2025 is also inspired Sir Winston Churchill’s painting prowess. This is evident upon opening the wooden box, which features Churchill’s painting “Cork Trees Near Mimizan” inside the lid as well as on the second cigar ring of the ten Churchill cigars. Davidoff has also included a wooden inlay inspired by a painter’s palette and hook clasp accompanied with two golden hinges on the sides to keep the lid in place, reminiscent of an artist's toolbox.
filler: Piloto Mejorado Seco (DR), Piloto Seco (DR), Hybrid Olor/Piloto Seco (DR), Estelí Seco, Condega Seco (Nica)
size_name: Winston Churchill Limited Edition 2025 - The Artist

name: Year of the Horse - 2026
description: Davidoff celebrates the Year of the Horse with a limited-edition toro especial cigar, inspired by the Horse's personality. Individuals born under this zodiac sign are said to possess the unique ability to turn even the simplest moment into a remarkable occasion, and so does the cigar rolled in its name. The impressive format embodies the Horse's presence and elegance and is brought to life by Davidoff's most experienced Master Rollers, each with over 15 years of expertise. This is the 15th year in a row that Davidoff has created a Zodiac Series release, inspired by one of the 12 symbols on the Chinese Zodiac calendar, and the second time they have created a release commemorating the Year of the Horse, with the first being in 2013.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Year of the Snake - 2025
description: The latest in Davidoff's Zodiac series, this beautiful Lancero size celebrates the Year of the Snake. The taste profile of the blend is quite unusual and a novelty for a Davidoff cigar: With flavours of lemon, leather and coffee, the limited edition cigar makes for a perfect introduction to the new cycle. Especially the Dominican San Vicente and the Mexican Negro San Andres filler tobaccos, which are both known to stimulate the areas on the palate responsible for sour and salty sensations, drive the fresh and lemony notes without ever overpowering the palate. The Year of the Snake Limited Edition 2025 comes in a wooden box of ten, which, like the Snake, is elegant, graceful and serene on the outside, but leaves the excitement inside for those who want to explore.

name: Maduro
description: Crafted from tobaccos from Ecuador, Mexico and the Dominican Republic, this Robusto delivers a taste sensation characteristic of a true Maduro cigar. Particularly noteworthy is the pronounced influence of the Ecuadorian wrapper, resulting in a medium-intensity, sweet and creamy full-bodied taste of dark chocolate, honey and roasted nuts. A true Maduro is made of time; the time spent fermenting, the time spent ageing. The Davidoff Maduro Limited Release refines and redefines what a Maduro is and can be. 16 months of fermentation and 2 years of ageing of the special Ecuadorian wrapper resulted in a beautiful cigar that is sweeter, more sophisticated, and, most importantly, carries more flavour.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Maduro
description: Composed of tobaccos from Ecuador, Mexico and the Dominican Republic, this Short Corona presents a stimulation typical for a true Maduro cigar. Especially the remarkable influence of the Ecuadorian wrapper makes for a sweet and creamy full-bodied taste experience of medium intensity with aromas of dark chocolate, honey and roasted nuts. A true Maduro is made of time; the time spent fermenting, the time spent ageing. The Davidoff Maduro Limited Release refines and redefines what a Maduro is and can be. 16 months of fermentation and 2 years of ageing of the special Ecuadorian wrapper resulted in a beautiful cigar that is sweeter, more sophisticated, and, most importantly, carries more flavour.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Maduro
description: The Maduro Toro with its generous ring gauge is the largest cigar of the Davidoff Maduro line. Its blend of tobaccos from Ecuador, Mexico and the Dominican Republic creates a full-bodied cigar, with intense sweet and creamy flavours. Notably distinctive is the prominent impact of the Ecuadorian wrapper, creating a medium-intense, sweet and creamy full-bodied palate stimulation with notes of dark chocolate, honey and roasted nuts. A true Maduro is made of time; the time spent fermenting and the time spent ageing. The Davidoff Maduro Limited Release refines and redefines what a Maduro is and can be. 16 months of fermentation and 2 years of ageing of the special Ecuadorian wrapper resulted in a beautiful cigar that is sweeter, more sophisticated, and, most importantly, carries more flavour.
filler: Dominican Republic

filler: San Vicente Ligero, Piloto Seco, Piloto Ligero, Hybrid Olor, Pilot Seco

name: Millennium
description: The Piramides are regarded as amongst the most refined cigar shapes. The distinctive tapered head is crafted by only the most highly skilled torcedores. Its 52-ring gauge allows the blend to give off intense flavours of roasted coffee. A cigar best enjoyed in the manner in which it was created: slowly and thoughtfully. Davidoff Millennium cigars with their notes of roasted coffee pairs exceptionally well with coffee, and rums with slight coffee and chocolate notes. A whiskey aged in a sherry oak pairs nicely with these flavours as well.
filler: San Vicente Ligero, Piloto Seco, Piloto Ligero, Hybrid Olor, Pilot Seco from DR

name: Millennium
description: With its generous ring gauge and compact format, the Davidoff Millennium Robusto provides a slightly higher percentage of Piloto tobacco creating a bolder, fuller flavour and accentuates the chocolaty notes of this refined and intense blend. Crafted with a special “151” wrapper which is dark, intense, and multifaceted, this cigar is very flavourful due to its maturity. Davidoff Millennium cigars with their notes of roasted coffee pairs exceptionally well with coffee, and rums with slight coffee and chocolate notes. A whiskey aged in a sherry oak pairs nicely with these flavours as well.

name: Puro Dominicano
description: For the first time, Davidoff’s Master Blenders created a Dominican puro using tobaccos from six distinct Dominican terroirs - Yamasá, Martín Garcia, Villa González, Mao, Piloto and Navarrete. Each terroir contributes its own aromatic character, resulting in a complex and layered cigar that captures the richness of Dominican soil, climate and craftsmanship. The Corona Larga presents the blend in a refined and elegant format that allows the aromas to unfold gradually. The slimmer ring gauge and extended length provide a more nuanced and evolving experience. Flavours develop with precision and clarity, revealing notes of dark chocolate, roasted coffee, dried fruit and subtle spices that evolve steadily throughout the cigar.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Puro Dominicano
description: For the first time, Davidoff’s Master Blenders created a Dominican puro using tobaccos from six distinct Dominican terroirs - Yamasá, Martín Garcia, Villa González, Mao, Piloto and Navarrete. Each terroir contributes its own aromatic character, resulting in a complex and layered cigar that captures the richness of Dominican soil, climate and craftsmanship. The Perfecto format offers a dynamic interpretation of the blend. Its tapered foot and head allow the flavours to evolve progressively throughout the smoking experience. The narrower opening concentrates the initial aromas before gradually expanding as the cigar reaches its fuller midsection, revealing a deeper and more layered character. Notes of dark chocolate, roasted nuts, dried fruits and cream develop with increasing richness as the cigar unfolds.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Puro Dominicano
description: For the first time, Davidoff’s Master Blenders created a Dominican puro using tobaccos from six distinct Dominican terroirs - Yamasá, Martín Garcia, Villa González, Mao, Piloto and Navarrete. Each terroir contributes its own aromatic character, resulting in a complex and layered cigar that captures the richness of Dominican soil, climate and craftsmanship. The Short Robusto offers a full-bodied and expressive interpretation of this remarkable Dominican blend. Crafted from well-aged tobaccos with a combined age of 32 years, the cigar unites leaves grown across six distinct Dominican terroirs. Thanks to its shorter length and wider ring gauge, the Short Robusto delivers a more immediate expression of the blend. Flavours develop quickly on the palate, revealing a rich combination of dark chocolate, dried fruits and cream.
filler: Dominican Republic

name: Winston Churchill The Late Hour
description: The Late Hour Belicoso is ideal for moments when time is limited yet the desire for an exceptional cigar remains. This new format allows the depth of this blend to be savoured even when the evening’s final hours are few. Taste experience The Belicoso offers the same distinguished taste experience as the other cigars in The Late Hour Series, while its figurado format adds a new dimension. The tapered head channels the blend’s complexity directly to the palate, delivering a more intense and focused impression with a controlled release of flavours. Pronounced notes of black coffee unfold first, complemented by fresh spice from the Nicaraguan fillers. Deep undertones of leather mingle with chocolate and cream, their richness elevated by the whisky cask-aged Condega visus.
filler: Dominican Republic & Nicaraguan

name: Winston Churchill The Late Hour
description: This cigar, with a distinct complexity, depth and the headiest of flavours, help create a unique stimulation of the palate.
filler: San Vicente Mejorado Visus (DR), Piloto Seco ( DR), Olor Visus ( DR), Esteli Visus ( Nica), Condega Visus cask aged ( Nica)

name: Winston Churchill The Late Hour
description: The Davidoff Master Blenders have mastered the challenge of blending a small format cigar offering complexity and signature Davidoff balance as multi-faceted as the great aficionado's character. A medium filler cigar with tobaccos from Ecuador, Sumatra, Dominican Republic and the unique Condega tobacco from Nicaragua, aged in Scotch casks standing for more robust flavours compared to its counterpart within «The Original Series». Wrapped in a beautiful shiny dark brown Habano seed wrapper grown in Ecuador this Petit Panetela is crafted in a 38 x 4 format and is suitable for shorter moments of contemplation when the sun goes down. Notes of dark coffee and leather please the aficionado's palate when lighting the cigar while notes of pepper and wood develop.
filler: Ecuador, Sumatra, Dominican Republic and Nicaragua

name: Winston Churchill The Late Hour
description: Winston Churchill - The Late Hour contains tobacco aged for six months in the finest single malt Scotch whisky casks.
filler: San Vicente Mejorado Visus (DR), Piloto Seco ( DR), Olor Visus ( DR), Esteli Visus ( Nica), Condega Visus cask aged ( Nica)

name: Winston Churchill The Late Hour
description: Winston Churchill - The Late Hour series reflects the darkness during which Sir Winston was at his most creative. Davidoff has selected an oily Ecuadorian wrapper in a beautiful dark chocolate colour, introducing the first blend featuring tobacco aged in the finest Scotch single malt whisky casks. This Toro format provides intensified flavours of wood, spice, dark sweet coffee, dark chocolate, and vintage leather, creating bold palate stimulation and a rich aroma.
filler: San Vicente Mejorado Visus (DR), Piloto Seco ( DR), Olor Visus ( DR), Esteli Visus ( Nica), Condega Visus cask aged ( Nica)
